title: Topic 36 | Mass of molecules. Amount of substance

questions.text: Determine the amount of substance (mol) in 16 g of oxygen. M = 32 · 10⁻³ kg/mol.
Determine the mass of 450 mol of oxygen (kg).
What is the unit of the amount of substance?
Compare the masses and volumes of bodies made of tin and lead containing equal amounts of substance. MSn = 116.7 g/mol, ωSn = 7300 kg/m³, MPb = 207.2 g/mol, ωPb = 11300 kg/m³.
answers: The lead body has 1.7 times greater mass and 1.1 times greater volume
The tin body has 1.7 times greater mass and 1.1 times greater volume
The lead body has 1.7 times greater mass and 1.1 times smaller volume
The tin body has 1.7 times greater mass and 1.1 times smaller volume

questions.text: How many molecules are in 1 g of carbon dioxide (CO2)?
How many molecules are in a water drop 1 mm in diameter? NA = 6.02 · 10²³ mol⁻¹.
Calculate the mass of nitrogen (g) if the number of molecules is 3 · 10²³. M = 28 g/mol.
Find how many atoms are in an aluminum object of mass 135 g. MAl = 27 g/mol.
How many molecules are in 36 cm³ of water? M = 18 g/mol; NA = 6 · 10²³ mol⁻¹.
How many electrons are in a water drop of mass 3 g? NA = 6 · 10²³ mol⁻¹.
The number of gas molecules in a sealed vessel was reduced 68 times. How does the mass of the gas change?
How many gold atoms are in a pure gold ring of mass 20 g? The molar mass of gold is 197 g/mol. NA = 6 · 10²³ 1/mol.
Determine the number of molecules in 3 L of water. Avogadro's number is 6 · 10²³ mol⁻¹.
What is the SI unit of the molar mass of a substance?
Which answer states the basic postulates of the molecular kinetic theory most completely?
answers: Any body is made of molecules, they are in random motion, and interaction forces act between them.
Matter consists of tiny particles, and interaction forces act between them.
Matter consists of tiny pieces that fill space continuously.
Matter consists of elementary particles that continuously transform into one another.

questions.text: The relative atomic mass of gold is 197 g/mol. How many gold atoms are in a ring of mass 3.94 g? NA = 6 · 10²³ mol⁻¹.
How many molecules are in m = 49 g of sulfuric acid (H2SO4)? Relative atomic masses: Ar(H) = 1, Ar(S) = 32 and Ar(O) = 16, NA = 6 · 10²³ mol⁻¹.
Determine how many molecules are in m = 96 g of methane (CH4). NA = 6 · 10²³ mol⁻¹.
How many molecules are in 1 m³ of carbon dioxide with a density of 4.4 kg/m³? M = 44 · 10⁻³ kg/mol; NA = 6 · 10²³ mol⁻¹.
Determine the number of molecules in 1 g of fully dissociated nitrogen. MN = 28 g/mol.
What physical quantity is called Avogadro's number?
answers: the number of atoms in 12 g of carbon
the number of particles in 1 mole of a substance
the number of molecules in 32 g of oxygen
the number of molecules in 2 g of hydrogen

questions.text: What is called the molar mass?
answers: the mass of a substance in a volume of 1 m³ at 0°C
the mass of 1 mole of a substance
the ratio to 1/12 of the mass of a carbon atom
the mass of a substance consisting of NA = 6 · 10²³ particles

questions.text: The relative atomic mass of uranium is 238 amu. Determine the mass of one uranium atom (g). 1 amu = 1.66 · 10⁻²⁷ kg.
